Program Overview
The Department of Civil & Mineral Engineering offers graduate programs leading to the Master of Engineering (MEng), Master of Applied Science (MASc), and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD).
MEng students can customize their experience through an optional project and/or by focusing their studies in one or more of our optional emphases. An extended full-time Co-op option that includes paid full-time work experience is also available.
Research-stream students will undertake advanced studies and research within one of our multidisciplinary research themes.
The department also offers a specialized graduate program in Cities Engineering & Management, leading to the Master of Engineering in Cities Engineering & Management (MEngCEM).
Students looking to complete both an undergraduate degree and a Master’s degree may be interested in the following combined degree programs:
Environmental Chemistry (Specialist), Honours Bachelor of Science / Civil Engineering, Master of Engineering​
Environmental Chemistry (Specialist Co-op), Honours Bachelor of Science / Civil Engineering, Master of Engineering

Statement of Land Acknowledgement
We wish to acknowledge this land on which the University of Toronto operates. For thousands of years it has been the traditional land of the Wendat Nation, the Seneca, and the Mississaugas of the Credit. Today, this meeting place is still the home to many Indigenous people from across Turtle Island and we are grateful to have the opportunity to work on this land.
